glosses.meaningKo: 손이나 방망이, 라켓 등을 휘둘러 누군가나 무언가를 치려고 하다
glosses.englishDescription: to try to hit someone or something by swinging a hand, bat, racket, or similar object
glosses.sourceDescription: to move in a particular direction with a smooth curving movement, or to make something move in this way
examples: Maya swung the bat at the soft practice ball.
Leo swung his racket at the foam ball.

glosses.meaningKo: 장소나 용기의 모든 부분을 검색하여 그 안에 있는 무언가를 찾으려고 노력하는 것
glosses.englishDescription: to try to find something inside a place or container by searching in every part of it
glosses.sourceDescription: to try to find something inside a place or container by searching in every part of it
examples: She dug around in her handbag for a pen.
She was digging around in her purse for a brush when a knock at the door startled her.

glosses.meaningKo: 땅을 파서 어떤 것을 흙에 섞다
glosses.englishDescription: to mix something into the ground by digging
glosses.sourceDescription: to mix something into the ground by digging
examples: We dug the compost in before planting the flowers.
Mina dug the dry leaves in to enrich the soil.

glosses.meaningKo: 새 식물을 심을 준비를 하려고 땅을 파서 고르다
glosses.englishDescription: to dig ground in order to prepare it for new plants
glosses.sourceDescription: to dig ground in order to prepare it for new plants
examples: We dig over the garden before planting new flowers.
Dad dug over the soil to prepare it for seeds.

glosses.meaningKo: 땅을 파서 땅 밑에서 무언가를 제거하기 위해서
glosses.englishDescription: to remove something from under the ground by digging
glosses.sourceDescription: to remove something from under the ground by digging
examples: They’ve been digging up the road outside our house.
We will have to dig that tree up.

glosses.meaningKo: 어떤 일이나 논의에 관여하다
glosses.englishDescription: to become involved in something
glosses.sourceDescription: to become involved in something
examples: Several students weighed in on the class discussion.
Our teacher weighed in with a helpful suggestion.

glosses.meaningKo: 토론이나 캠페인에 적극적으로 끼어들며, 흔히 누군가를 강하게 비판하다
glosses.englishDescription: to become forcefully involved in a discussion or campaign, often by criticizing someone
glosses.sourceDescription: to start to criticize or blame someone angrily
examples: The Institute of Directors has weighed into the campaign.
The organization weighed into companies for not making these conditions clear to clients.

glosses.meaningKo: 누군가나 무언가에 문제를 일으키거나, 누군가를 걱정하게 만들기 위해서
glosses.englishDescription: to cause problems for someone or something, or to make someone worried
glosses.sourceDescription: to cause problems for someone or something, or to make someone worried
examples: The decision to move has been weighing heavily on Eric’s mind.
The responsibility of her new job had begun to weigh on her.

glosses.meaningKo: 스위치를 눌러 다른 텔레비전 또는 라디오 프로그램을 보거나 듣기 시작하세요
glosses.englishDescription: to start watching or listening to a different television or radio programme by pressing a switch
glosses.sourceDescription: to start watching or listening to a different television or radio programme by pressing a switch
examples: Can’t we switch over to Channel 4?
I just switch over right away.

glosses.meaningKo: 이야기나 상황, 감정 등에 완전히 빠져들다
glosses.englishDescription: to become completely involved in a story, situation, your emotions etc
glosses.sourceDescription: to become completely involved in a story, situation, your emotions etc
examples: An exciting story can sweep Mina away for an hour.
We were swept away by the music at the school concert.

glosses.meaningKo: 브러시나 빗자루를 사용하여 바닥이나 지면의 먼지, 유리, 먼지 등을 청소하고 제거합니다
glosses.englishDescription: to clean and remove dirt, glass, dust etc from a floor or the ground using a brush or broom
glosses.sourceDescription: to clean and remove dirt, glass, dust etc from a floor or the ground using a brush or broom
examples: I’m going to sweep up.
Would you sweep up the broken glass?

glosses.meaningKo: 빙글 돌리다; 몸을 홱 돌리다
glosses.englishDescription: to turn quickly, or make someone turn quickly, to face another direction
glosses.sourceDescription: same as spin
examples: He put a hand on the boy’s shoulder and spun him round.
She spun round to face him.

glosses.meaningKo: 결국 다른 사람이 원하는 대로 하기로 동의하다
glosses.englishDescription: to finally agree to do what someone else wants you to do
glosses.sourceDescription: to finally agree to do what someone else wants you to do
examples: The committee yielded to the students' request for more shade.
Dad yielded to our request for a weekend picnic.

glosses.meaningKo: 사물의 그룹을 일련의 형태로 배열하기 위해서
glosses.englishDescription: to arrange a group of things into a series
glosses.sourceDescription: to arrange a group of things into a series
examples: They now need to string together a series of festive wins to stay within striking distance of the top four.
We couldn't string together one phase.

glosses.meaningKo: 정직하지 않거나 옳지 않다고 여겨 찬성하지 않다
glosses.englishDescription: to not approve of something because you think that it is dishonest or immoral
glosses.sourceDescription: to not approve of something because you think that it is dishonest or immoral
examples: Mina disagrees with copying someone else's homework.
Our class disagreed with hiding the true results.

glosses.meaningKo: 두 생각이나 설명이 서로 모순되지 않고 타당하게 들어맞다
glosses.englishDescription: if one idea, opinion, explanation etc squares with another, they both seem good or reasonable
glosses.sourceDescription: if one idea, opinion, explanation etc squares with another, they both seem good or reasonable
examples: Your explanation should square with the facts we collected.
The new schedule does not square with our original plan.
